source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the stick seen straight from behind (pilot's view), head with display, P1/H1, FIRE B25, B23/B24 and the S wheel toward the camera, base levers L1 (left) and L2 (right)
mappingSource: catalog (turtlebeach.json, confidence low: "Numbering not documented"; controls per https://www.turtlebeach.com/products/velocity-one-flight-stick-ii: Hall stick X/Y, lockable twist rudder, dual levers, thumbstick, multi-function wheel). Which control is which part is read from the labels printed on the device: P1 "RxRy, push B18" = thumbstick, the ribbed wheel "S, push B21" below FIRE = multi-function wheel, base levers L1 (TOGA/100%/0%/REV scale) and L2 (UP/DOWN scale)
note: The catalog part "throttle.axis" (type button, inputs left/right) stands for the two base levers; it is marked on L1 (left, throttle scale); L2 (right, UP/DOWN scale) is at about 0.620 0.590. The photo shows many controls the catalog has no part for: H1 hat (NAV), FIRE B25, B23/B24, the eight green base buttons B1-B4 / B27-B30, the ALTITUDE/SPEED dual encoder (B10-17), START/STOP and B31-B33.
